A '''Sith Citadel''' existed within the [[Valley of the Dark Lords/Legends|Valley of the Dark Lords]] on the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] world of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] around the time of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]] in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]].

[[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Alema Rar]] came to this citadel in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]] but was captured by [[White Eyes]] and his thugs. She had originally come to find help for [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Caedus]], formerly [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] Jacen Solo. But these Sith did not want to help Rar after examining her, though when White Eyes was convinced he gave the [[Holocron of Darth Vectivus|holocron]] of [[Darth Vectivus]] to Rar to give to Caedus.

In a discussion between Rar and the Sith on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], the leader of the Sith enclave made references to the [[Darth Krayt|collective master]] of the Sith. He told Alema of how the Jedi-turned-Sith [[Vergere]] had been fascinated by their master's vision of [[One Sith]] as opposed to keeping to the tradition of the [[Rule of Two/Legends|Rule of Two]], however said master would later reflect she disagreed with his plan.
